mapper.select: SELECT id AS missionId, title, description, mission_type AS missionType, trigger_event AS triggerEvent, target_count AS targetCount, reward_point AS rewardPoint, created_at AS createdAt FROM mission
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{missionType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetCount}, #{rewardPoint})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, mission_type = #{missionType}, trigger_event = #{triggerEvent}, target_count = #{targetCount}, reward_point = #{rewardPoint} WHERE id = #{missionId}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.progress_id AS id, mp.user_id AS userId, mp.mission_id AS missionId, mp.status, mp.start_date AS startDate, mp.end_date AS endDate, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM mission_progress mp JOIN mission m ON mp.mission_id = m.id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT mp.progress_id AS id, mp.user_id AS userId, mp.mission_id AS missionId, mp.status, mp.start_date AS startDate, mp.end_date AS endDate, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM mission_progress mp JOIN mission m ON mp.mission_id = m.id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId} AND mp.mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (user_id, mission_id, point, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{rewardPoint}, #{type}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT mp.progress_id AS id, mp.user_id AS userId, mp.mission_id AS missionId, mp.status, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM mission_progress mp JOIN mission m ON mp.mission_id = m.id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId} AND m.trigger_event = #{triggerEvent} AND mp.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
